title: Construction: three-stage persistent prefix shear chain (no new kappa)
body:
## Result

This adds a three-stage target-to-source prefix chain for arbitrary dirty F2 rows and arbitrary linear maps. Each updated output feeds the next complete call:

```text
y1 += A1(x)
y2 += A2(y1 updated)
y3 += A3(y2 updated)
```

The exact block map is recorded in the package README. It produces the nested prefix terms `A2 A1 x`, `A3 A2 y1`, and `A3 A2 A1 x` without a clean target, a dirty connector, or an inverse cleanup. More generally, n stages call each `A_i` once, while independent source-path expansion calls it i times.

The complete local bill separates map calls, scalar staging, root program/control, row hosting and handoff adapters. For n=3 the map-call comparison is `c1+c2+c3` versus `c1+2c2+3c3`. The target-hidden expansion also needs three clean scratch rows, three copied target rows, `9L` scalar staging writes/XORs, and six additional full rows; the chain needs no additional row or scalar staging. The L=2 noncommuting U/L/U fixture uses 6 map XORs in the chain versus 12 map XORs plus 18 staging operations in the expansion. Program and allocation costs remain separate charges.

The scope avoids the live two-call composite cross-feed question in [Discussion #1884](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1884). Related mutable-source or connector work includes [PR #1439](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1439) (head `3852c2d03044895cebdc9b31b0c7131a617774d2`), [PR #1524](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1524) (head `5c1f39788a0fc669b7e37e27785c63e85788c350`), [PR #1637](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1637) (head `9bee6cc01f151b92ccfe147046855715843f066a`), [PR #1739](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1739) (head `e33645b34521460bce61f9fb913f98f506d34d4d`) and [PR #1780](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1780) (head `15a91b5d634023a3a14129cbb240854c4b188111`). This package uses no predecessor implementation. Its output-to-source lifetime and three-stage block map differ from their source mutation, connector correction, transfer or delivery-cut contracts.

## Reproduction and limits

```sh
python3 -B research/recursive-prefix-shear-chain-seed68355377/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/recursive-prefix-shear-chain-seed68355377 --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/recursive-prefix-shear-chain-seed68355377
```

The direct verifier passed all 1,048,576 map/state cases and four negative controls on Python 3.14.7. The package metadata and source-pin check passed. This environment has no Python 3.12, so the registered Python 3.12 replay is pending hosted CI.

This is a local recursive-interface construction only. It has not been bound to a selected supplier call pair, frames, hosting, precision or tape cost; it establishes no new `kappa`. The selected record is unchanged. No independent human review is claimed.

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in construction, exact verification, cost accounting and writing. Apache-2.0.
